Fetch Weather Data for One Task

Source: R/fetch_epicrop_weather_list.R
dot-fetch_one_weather.Rd

Calls the API to fetch weather data for a single (location, start, duration) task and splits the result by calendar year into a named list.

Usage

.fetch_one_weather(task, source = "power")

Arguments

task

A task object (from .create_single_task()) with:

  • lonlat: numeric vector c(lon, lat)

  • start_chr: character start date

  • duration: integer duration

Value

An epicrop.wth.list object: a named list of weather tables, one per year. Names are year strings (e.g., "2000", "2001").

Details

This function calls get_wth() to fetch data, then splits by year. It is called internally by fetch_epicrop_weather_list().

Return Structure

The weather table is split by data.table::year(YYYYMMDD) into a list. Each list element is a table for one calendar year, named by the year. The result is classed as epicrop.wth.list.
